meaning:
ransom, redemption
Another spelling of pid.yon (פִּדְיוֹן "redemption" H6306B)

elsewhere.note: If a ransom is imposed on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is imposed.
Moses took the redemption money from those who exceeded the number of those who were redeemed by the Levites;
For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,
